note: What a client sends once it has taken in a group of movements, naming which group and listing the units the group asked it to relocate. The header names no object: it carries zero.

fields.name: syncId
fields.note: The number of the group it answers.

fields.name: relocationCount
fields.note: How many of the group's paths carried a teleport token.

fields.name: relocations
unit
fields.note: The unit.

fields.name: token
fields.note: The token its path carried.
Each of those, in the group's order.

revisions.note: What a client sends for every WaypointGroup it takes. The header names no object: it carries zero.

fields.name: syncId
fields.note: Which group is being acknowledged, as the group named itself.

fields.name: relocationCount
fields.note: How many relocations follow. Answering WaypointGroup a client counts them; answering a path for one unit it sends only syncId and this byte, unwritten, on the transient channel, and no relocations, so a server reads nothing in it there.

fields.note: The unit the token belonged to.
